subject: Bridgewater pilot — combine onboarding credit + introductory rate request
messages:
From: Sasha Levin <sasha@bridgewater.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Nate Brooks <nate@bridgewater.ai>, procurement@bridgewater.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot scope + ask on onboarding credit / intro rate

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Bridgewater is excited to run the 6-week pilot (approx. 1.2M tokens/month) to validate the summarization and agent workflows. Two asks from my side as we prep SOW: 1) would Redwood consider a combined onboarding credit to offset usage for the first month ( ~50k tokens worth) and 2) an introductory per-token rate for the pilot term (30% off list) so we can model economics while the integration completes?

Both items will help us move procurement faster — procurement asked we consolidate concession asks into a single request to your leadership. I attached a draft SOW and a high-level usage estimate.

Sasha
Sasha Levin
Head of Integrations, Bridgewater AI
Attachments: bridgewater_statement_of_work_v1.pdf, bridgewater_pricing_spreadsheet_v2.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Levin <sasha@bridgewater.ai>
Cc: Nate Brooks <nate@bridgewater.ai>, procurement@bridgewater.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot scope + ask on onboarding credit / intro rate

Hi Sasha —

Appreciate the clear asks and the SOW — this is sensible. I can push a combined ask up for exec approval (onboarding credit + introductory rate for the pilot). Two quick clarifications to speed review:

- Confirm the 50k token credit target you mentioned is a flat credit (token-equivalent) or you prefer a $ credit?
- Would Bridgewater be willing to commit to a short post-pilot pilot-to-paid conversion clause (e.g., 3-month minimum committed term) if the pilot meets the agreed success metrics? That helps make the economics workable for our execs.

I'll loop in Revenue Operations and Marissa for approval and include the SOW and pricing sheet in the approval pack.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Bridgewater pilot — combined ask (need exec packet)

Karthik / Aditya —

Looping you both to prepare the ask. Summary: Bridgewater requests a 50k-token onboarding credit + 30% introductory rate for a 6-week pilot (estimated 1.2M tokens/month). Procurement wants consolidated approval.

What I need from RevOps (Aditya): 1) model P&L impact for 3 scenarios (no conversion, 50% conversion at standard ARR, 80% conversion at discounted ARR) and 2) recommended approval threshold.

Priyom — please flag any legal concerns if we make the rate limitation pilot-only and what guardrails we should require in the SOW (term, data handling, audit rights).

Targeting leadership queue by Friday EOD.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 10:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Bridgewater pilot — combined ask (need exec packet)

Marissa —

Attached is a quick model (high-level) and the incremental impact with the 50k credit + 30% pilot rate assumption. Key takeaways:
- If Bridgewater does not convert post-pilot, the total immediate revenue impact is approx $2.4k (we classify this under go-to-market promotional allowances).
- At 50% conversion to a 12-month term at 70% of list, NPV is clearly positive given average deal size for this segment.
- Recommend we approve the combined ask as a one-time promo (cap: single pilot term) conditioned on a short commitment if they convert (3 months min), and a one-time exec-level grace if usage spikes beyond estimates.

I'll hand this to Priyom for legal/OPS language; if you want, I can also draft the short exec summary bullet page.

Aditya Rao
Revenue Operations
Attachments: brg_promo_model_v1.xlsx (referenced inline)
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridgewater pilot — combined ask (need exec packet)

Team —

Legal / Rev Ops review complete. Proposed guardrails for exec packet:
1) Onboarding credit = token-equivalent credit of 50,000 tokens (non-transferable, expires 45 days from pilot start).
2) Introductory rate = 30% off list for pilot duration only; fee reverts to list on conversion.
3) If Bridgewater converts within 30 days of pilot completion, they must sign a minimum 3-month paid term at agreed post-pilot rate; early termination of that paid term will forfeit any remaining onboarding credit value.
4) Require standard DPA + SOC2 attestation clause in SOW (they already provided vendor form — we will counter a few data isolation lines).
5) Cap total promo liability at $10k for accounting/finance sign-off.

I drafted the exact bullet summary for exec email below. Ready to send once Marissa approves language.

Priyom Das
Senior Contracts Counsel
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Redwood Exec Approvals <exec-approvals@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 16:24:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request — Bridgewater AI pilot concession (one-time onboarding credit + pilot rate)

Team —

Request: Approval to grant Bridgewater AI the following one-time concessions to accelerate pilot kickoff:
- Onboarding credit: 50,000 token-equivalent credit (expires 45 days after pilot start).
- Introductory pilot rate: 30% off list for the 6-week pilot term.
- Liability cap: promo exposure capped at $10k.
- Conversion guardrail: 3-month minimum paid term if they sign within 30 days of pilot completion; early termination forfeits remaining credit value.

Rationale: Bridgewater is a high-fit prospect for our summarization + agent product. The pilot is expected to surface cross-sell opportunities into the enterprise analytics team. RevOps model projects positive NPV given our standard conversion assumptions; exposure is limited by the $10k cap. Legal has reviewed and provided required SOW/DPA guardrails.

Attachments: bridgewater_statement_of_work_v1.pdf, bridgewater_pricing_spreadsheet_v2.xlsx

Approve?
- Marissa (for sales leadership)
- Aditya (RevOps recommend APPROVE)
- Priyom (Legal cleared)

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
